subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter & what to share
messages:
From: Emily Turner <emily.turner@veridianhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@veridianhealth.com
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and potential bridge letter

Hi Jordan,

We're finalizing Veridian Health's vendor security review and need Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II report covering the period ending 2025-04-30 (or closest audit period). Our procurement team also asks whether you can provide a bridge letter if the audit period does not cover our required timeframe.

Specifically could you: 
- Confirm the most recent Type II audit period and whether you have a public report we can download.
- Let us know if Redwood will provide a bridge letter that attests to controls since the last report (and, if so, typical scope/format).
- Share any standard redacted summary or one-page compliance datasheet you use with prospects.

We treat this as time-sensitive for our Q3 vendor approvals. If easier, a short templated response we can include in our packet would be helpful.

Thanks,
Emily Turner
Senior Procurement Manager
Veridian Health
[Attachment: Veridian_Vendor_Checklist_2025.xlsx]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Turner <emily.turner@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and potential bridge letter

Emily — thanks for reaching out and for the clear list. Quick answers up front, and below that I pasted a short template you can include in your packet. I've also attached our one-page compliance summary and a redacted SOC 2 index.

High level:
- Latest SOC 2 Type II report: Audit period 2024-05-01 to 2025-04-30. Redacted report is available on request under an NDA; we can provide a downloadable copy via secure link to your security team.
- Bridge letter: We can provide a standard bridge letter covering interim period up to 2025-07-31 that confirms controls are in place and unchanged since the last report; legal prefers a short attestation + scope list.

What we normally share for initial reviews (and what I've attached):
1) Redacted SOC 2 summary (PDF) — one-page executive summary of scope and opinion.
2) Evidence index (Excel) — mapping of typical questions to evidence we can provide.
3) Bridge letter template (DOCX) — legal-approved template we can fill and sign.

Suggested short template text you may use in your packet (feel free to paste):
"Redwood Inference has completed a SOC 2 Type II audit for the period 2024-05-01 to 2025-04-30. A redacted report and an executive summary are available on request under NDA. Redwood can provide a bridge letter attesting that controls remained in effect through 2025-07-31. For access to the full report or to request a bridge letter, please contact security@redwood.com."

Next steps from our side: Marissa (Compliance) — can you confirm the preferred NDA link for sharing the redacted report and advise on turnaround for a signed bridge letter? Neha — looping in legal for any procurement-specific language they'll want in the final letter.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com] | +1 (415) 555-0142
[Attachment: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Turner <emily.turner@veridianhealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and potential bridge letter

Hi Emily — Marissa from Compliance here. Thanks for the note. A few clarifications and what we'll need if you want the redacted report and bridge letter: 

Clarifications:
- Audit period we have on file: 2024-05-01 to 2025-04-30 (Type II).
- Bridge letters are issued only to named customer contacts and require a short confidentiality acknowledgment (we'll share a one-click NDA link).

What we can send now (attached):
- Redwood SOC 2 executive summary (PDF) — suitable for procurement packets.
- Evidence index (Excel) — identifies typical controls and sample evidence we can provide after NDA.
- Bridge letter template (DOCX) — note the template includes a standard scope paragraph and a list of control families covered.

If you'd like the full redacted report and a signed bridge letter, please have the customer sign the attached confidentiality acknowledgment here: https://drive.google.com/redwood/soc2-nda (link attached above). Once we receive the signed acknowledgement, we typically: 
- Provide a secure download link to the redacted Type II report (SLA: 2 business days).
- Draft a bridge letter and route to Legal for signature (SLA: 3–5 business days).

Attachments included in this message: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, redwood_bridge_letter_template.docx, redwood_evidence_index.xlsx

If Veridian's procurement needs a slightly different bridge timeframe (e.g., through 2025-09-30), we can discuss extensions — legal will need the specific requirement.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Compliance | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0267
[Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, redwood_bridge_letter_template.docx, redwood_evidence_index.xlsx]
